title: Misthare supreme

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Misthare supreme is a Mistlands-tier food.

sections.heading: Recipe
sections.text:
Uncooked misthare supreme is produced in a Food preparation table with:
• 1 Hare meat
• 3 Jotun puffs
• 2 Carrot
Misthare supreme is produced by cooking Uncooked misthare supreme in a Stone oven for 50 seconds. If left in the oven for 100 seconds, it will burn and turn into Coal.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Misthare supreme provides the highest health gain in the Mistlands at 85.
• This dish is both powerful and efficient - requiring only farmable Jotun puffs and Carrots means that all the player must leave their base for is to hunt Hares, which can also be trapped.
